description: Trame verte et bleue: les réservoirs is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Un des engagements phares du Grenelle de l’environnement, la Trame verte et bleue (TVB) constitue un outil de préservation de la biodiversité visant à intégrer les enjeux de maintien et de renforcement de la fonctionnalité des milieux naturels dans les outils de planification et les projets d’aménagement. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are tvb, trame verte et bleue, Strasbourg. The portal shows 25 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
